newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Serbs oust Moslems in mortar attack on village.
newsitem.headline: Serbs oust Moslems in mortar attack on village.

text.p: Bosnian Serb troops and police firing mortars drove Moslems out of the disputed village of Gajevi in one of the worst incidents of violence since the end of the Bosnian war, witnesses said on Tuesday.
They told a Reuter correspondent in the nearby town of Celic in northeast Bosnia that two Moslem men were injured, one with a serious head wound, during the three-hour attack.
The witnesses said up to 300 Serbs clad in black uniforms began the assault at 7 a.m. and claimed that Russian peacekeeping troops stood by without intervening.

NATO peacekeepers reported earlier that shooting and explosions were heard around the village, in Serb territory which Moslems are trying to repopulate, but could not confirm Moslem claims that they were under attack by Serbs.
Around 600 Moslems including women and children were in Gajevi on Monday but it was not known how many had stayed overnight.
The witnesses said no Moslems were left in the village after the attack on Tuesday morning.
